game.title: Road Stream Racer
game.description: Foundation scaffold for a streaming-road racing runner game: a one-hand portrait falling-hazard arcade (oncoming objects fall toward the player) with themed naming and palette. This spec builds the arcade shell ONLY — the described loop is not expressible in schema v1. Intended game: A portrait mobile racing runner where the road itself streams downward in reusable segments while the player changes lanes, dodges traffic, collects coins, and risks boost pads.

_note: GENRE TRAP WARNING — read before running factory:make with this spec. The `racing` block below is a HAND-OFF CONTRACT for the custom implementation, not generator input: no code under dev_game/generator/src reads it, and schema v1 does not declare it (it passes validation only because additionalProperties is unset). Schema v1 has no vocabulary for road segment streaming, lanes, or speed/nitro systems, so the mechanical fields describe a falling-hazard arcade and nothing else. Running this spec through factory:make yields a playable dodge-the-hazard game with themed labels — that is a scaffold, not the described game, and must not be reported as one. For a genre outside the v1 arcade vocabulary, use schema v2 with buildDecision 'custom-loop' instead of relabeling this one.
